note: Aspen-Sopris RD (White River NF); at 10,500 ft in lodgepole pine on CO-82 (Independence Pass Road) about 14 miles east of Aspen, across the highway from Lost Man Trailhead (Hunter-Fryingpan Wilderness), near Lost Man Reservoir and the Roaring Fork headwaters. --Claude

flags: Missing phone: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (970) 963-2266 (FS campground page office block).
Website is the White River NF home page; give the campground's own FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/lost-man-campground.

CO-82 Independence Pass: FS page 'Absolutely no vehicles over 35 feet in length, or vehicle/trailer combinations over 35 feet in length, are permitted between MP 47.2 (Aspen side) and MP 84.2 (Leadville/Twin Lakes side)'. The campground is 14 miles east of Aspen, on the Aspen side of the pass summit and inside the restricted stretch from either approach; a 23-ft rig is not affected. The pass road closes for winter, so access is seasonal.
Status: no White River alert names Lost Man or CO-82; open per the table's season (5/21-10/15).

Waterfront: stored not waterfront confirmed. On imagery the sites sit in lodgepole south of CO-82; the Roaring Fork runs through the open meadow north of the highway, ~100 m+ away with the road between.
Pin 39.12151,-106.6245 matches the FS page coordinate (39.121509,-106.624501), at the campground entrance off CO-82. No catalog. OK.
